newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity's U.S. stock funds add net $1 bln in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity's U.S. stock funds add net $1 bln in Sept.

text.p: Fidelity Investments estimated net cash inflows into its U.S. stock funds of more than $1 billion in September, a spokeswoman said Wednesday.

Cash flows into its international equity funds were flat during the month, while bond funds were "slightly positive" and the money market funds had inflows of nearly $1 billion, Fidelity spokeswoman Robyn Tice said.
"September appears to be a mirror image of August," Tice said.

Earlier, the Investment Company Institute, an industry trade group, said cash flows into U.S. stock mutual funds were an estimated $16 billion in September versus $17.93 billion in August. Bond and income funds had net inflow of about $1.5 billion for the month versus $1.6 billion in August, the ICI said.
